notes.title: Demon Turf is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Fabraz and Playtonic are excited to present: Demon Turf! [b]Which is out RIGHT NOW![/b] To celebrate we've also done a large patch for this Trials demo, to make sure it is up to snuff.

Now go and grab the main game if you liked the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf/

[previewyoutube=YNecpV_5lus;full][/previewyoutube]

We're absolutely over the moon it's finally out there! We hope you have a blast with Beebz's adventure through the demon turfs!

notes.title: Demon Turf is out now!
notes.content: And to celebrate we have one final update for the demo to catch it up to the release version! Hooay!

notes.title: Demon Turf is launching November 4th!
notes.content:
It's time! It's finally time! After three years of development everyone at Fabraz and Playtonic is excited to announce that Demon Turf, our 3D Platformer with attitude, [b]launches on November 4th[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf/

Are you ready to take on the Demon KIng with Beebz?! Check out our new launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=YNecpV_5lus;full][/previewyoutube]
But that's not all folks! We're also launching a timed contest until launch with Demon Turf Trials to win copies of the main game! Whaaaaaat?!~

What's the contest you ask? Check out this helpful image for the rules:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967636/4f0ecbb7206a096a6ef585a56540b837e802d7d0.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451650/Demon_Turf_Trials/][/url]
Please head on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/fabraz]discord [/url]to submit any video footage! Or to just join the Demon Turf discourse!

We can't WAIT for you to discover the world of Demon Turf. See you soon!

notes.title: The Demon Turf Trials Contest is officially over!
notes.content:
Ladies, gentlemen and everything in-between... We have the final winner. The winner of the 30th trial is [i]*drum roll*[/i]... [b]Lilly[/b]! This absolute champion kept their leading spot all week and squeezed in one final sub-30 in, literally, the last minute. What a perfect finish!

This, sadly, means the contest is finally over! After 30 weeks of intense speedrunning we've now gone through all of the available trials and looped back to the first. The demo will remain up, the trials will continue to unlock in the same order every week and we're keeping the leaderboards up as well, you simply can't win a portrait and/or shirt anymore.

[b]Talking of portraits.... Check out this spectacular wall of champions:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967636/842773bc56563d5bb69ed37858aa477f4fed4fea.png[/img]

[b]Here's a closer look at all 30 portraits made:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967636/d87b896856c4267007c2ceac0cfe959b6e52d3a0.png[/img]

[b]And here's the list of names of all the winners:[/b]
Nitro, SewnChaos, TanukiTale, Glint, MuRiFO, Sad, Webbinmaine, belastbarkeit, pixeldasher, DerHundMitEinemGrund, Miraraa, Renew, Aldarn, IlluminatiKowka, Lunalia, Arimic, Senap, Disaster, sonicyellow, Dynamix, Sperbs, teddy, TischFracht, Tensen, HolyCookie, Cruz, GoBlue, Chickenrio, ArcenDash and Lilly.

Another big applause to all of the winners! Curious where you're going to see their names & portraits in-game? [url=https://twitter.com/Fabrazz/status/1408455700477628423]Check out this tweet![/url]

Last but not least, we've [b]updated the game[/b] again with new performance improvements, loading improvements, balancing changes, bug fixes and lots of polish all over the place. Our eyes are now set on the[b] final release of Demon Turf[/b] and we can't wait for y'all to dive in soon!

[b][u]In the mean time, why don't you give us a wishlist! This helps us a lot! Until next time peeps![/u][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325900/Demon_Turf

notes.title: Mini Patch Time!
notes.content:
[b]Settings[/b]
- Added GUI scale slider.
- Added option to require spin input for dribble.
- Added gameplay setting subheaders for better readability.
- Set Vsync default to off due to streaming issues it can cause.

[b]Sounds[/b]
- Added a lot of new sounds.
- Improved a lot of sounds & their implementation.

[b]Other[/b]
- Improved a bunch of menu navigation in menus/pause etc.
- Improved a bunch of NPC & critter feedback on hits.
- Improved camera control during transitions.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed Glide-Ceiling bug.
- Fixed a bunch of menu bugs.
- Fixed a bunch of time out bugs.
- You can see the battery again when picking it up. (lol)

& Tons of other fixes & polish I can't remember.

notes.title: Demon Turf Trial's just got a MEGA UPDATE!
notes.content:
This update is a DOOZY but before we jump into that, let's celebrate 20 weeks worth of Trials so far! 20 champions with incredible times! 20 awesome Trials that we all competed in! This is...

[h2]Demon Turf Trials![/h2]
[previewyoutube=8sbLae6XAYg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

Alright, now to the main event: The MEGA Patch! What's in it? So much. So, so much. Check it out!

[b]PERFORMANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance has been drastically improved through fundamental, structural changes behind the scenes. Your game will likely perform significantly better now even on older machines.
[*] We have added more settings to adjust performance per machine including the option to turn off Depth of Field Blur, Bloom and lights at a distance.
[*] Improved start up time & memory usage in general.
[*] Significantly faster loading times for a majority of levels.
[/list]

[b]VISUALS[/b]
[list]
[*] All levels have been spruced up when it comes to color grading, shadow strength, lighting and general ambience.
[*] New Anti Aliasing method has been added that makes those jaggies silky smooth, turned on by default.
[*] Shadows are now set to close fit at the highest quality setting, good bye jitters!
[*] Gamma setting values now more accurately brighten up the screen.
[*] New outline shader that comes with adjusted visuals and fades at a distance to lower background noise
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Super Dribble! Hold down the jump input during a super jump to bounce off the floor, let go right when landing for an extra high bounce!
[*] Glide exit now has a greater momentum applied to it.
[*] Glide swoops now have a greater buffer time, so they are easier to do.
[*] Ground glide now allows you to jump out of it for quick successive punch attacks!
[*] Rollout trigger in the air now has more height again, but falls faster after a few seconds.
[*] Punch charges faster now & has a temporary speed burst. 
[*] Charged punches hit harder and jabs can be executed faster.
[*] You can now jab in the air and air punches can be aimed in general.
[*] Holding forward or not no longer matters during rollout jumps.
[*] Adjusted camera values in moves like surface swim boosting & hookshotting + unlocks.
[*] Wall cling is now slightly less clingy.
[*] If you get stuck in some geometry you receive a little push vertically after a few seconds.
[/list]

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
[list]
[*] X and Y camera values have now been separated for each individual ability
[*] Gamepad sensitivity sliders have a much higher max value now to compete with mouse players.
[*] You can now display your total play time in the GUI at all times, it even pauses during loading screens for any% runs.
[*] You can now type in & display your username in the GUI for streams/recordings.
[*] Added official ultra wide support to the game.
[/list]

[b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b]
[list]
[*] Level design has been polished up everywhere.
[*] Tutorial level now has a more interesting combat tutorial & explains jabs during the weight plate section.
[*] Arena visuals have been adjusted and it now looks more like it’s taking place in Forktown
[*] Enemies now spawn in when entering combat zones and aren’t there beforehand anymore
[/list]

[b]GUI[/b]
[list]
[*] New visual when beating conditional zones.
[*] GUI has been slightly sized up. (Will have a scale slider in the near future.)
[*] Battery Thief is now accessible in the Quest menu. 
[*] Hold inputs have been emphasized in tutorials and moveset menu.
[*] Added checkpoint hinters in Apocadesert levels as a reminder to players.
[*] Added a new selfie in the loading screen.
[*] Leaderboards now accurately display dyes & mods.
[/list]

[b]MISC[/b]
[list]
[*] More bug fixes and polishes than I can remember. So, so many…
[*] Tons of new, tweaked & improved sound effects.
[*] Restarting the game after a failed leaderboard submission will now resubmit your time properly. We swear it works now! Probably.
[*] Improved sweet finder arrow
[*] Fixed intro sweep timing & pacing.
[*] Updated credits
[*] Intro cutscene now skippable, you’re welcome runners!
[*] Added Playtonic Friends splash screen & more..!
[*] Added staging system to avoid long black screen on startup of the application.
[*] Fancy exit animation for level gates.
[/list]

[h1]This Week's Winner[/h1]
Pretty dope, right? Let us know what you think! Now, who won this week? Number 1 spot by a WIDE margin, congratulations to Trial Winner #20: [b]Dynamix[/b]!
INCREDIBLE time, gg!

The next trial is another racer!

Good luck out there, champions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967636/4f5e8fdcf30ad2de0597085b20bf57b2fdfe9280.png[/img]

Additionally, we also pushed out a patch, check it out!!

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Discord Rich Presence has been added.
[*] Optional bindable "reset level" button has been added to the control remapper.
[/list]

[b]Balancing/Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera zoom in/out is now remembered across levels & resets.
[*] You can no longer glide out of a rollout when entering it mid-air.
[*] A rollout mid-air now always yields the same height, independent to rising/falling.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] If you perfectly time a  jump or bounce during a hookshot it no longer locks your controls/camera.
[*] Hookshot targeting has been slightly altered to be more precise when the camera is zoomed out.
[*] Manually respawning during certain actions no longer leads to some animations & actions getting stuck.
[*] You now properly fall/slide when standing past a bevelled edge.
[*] Holding forward no longer negatively affects things like the rollout jump's speed.
[*] Punching during a side jump and similar actions no longer abuses the momentum gain.
[*] If your level time is clearly impossibly fast, it will no longer be submitted to the leaderboards.
[*] Toggling the same turf hotkey twice no longer clears out your toggle history.
[*] Leaving the leaderboards in the quest tab now returns your mouse control.
[*] Leaderboards with less than 6 entries now scoll correctly.
[*] You can no longer toggle the pause menus during hint pop-ups.
[*] Arrows for navigating photos are now clearer.
[*] Normal expression no longer skipped when you cycle to the left during selfies and always display the right text.
[/list]

notes.title: Huge Update! This demo just got BIGGER!
notes.content:
What's that? This demo just got a massive update?! That's right! You can now play past the tutorial and experience an expanded demo of the main game! Experience more of the story as you explore the hubs & tackle two entire main levels! *gasp*

On top of that, we also added a playground where you can experiment with Beebz' moveset in a safe environment and quickly learn more about the turf abilities you'd usually unlock much later in the game! Crucial if you want to compete in the weekly Trials!

And not only that, we're also bringing along a bunch of fixes, balancing changes & new features that were heavily requested by YOU, our community!

[b]Check out the patch notes below you hungry hungry hippos:[/b]
[list]
[*]THE BIG ONE: You can now play past the tutorial and experience an expanded demo of the main game! Experience more of the story as you explore the hubs & tackle two main levels!

[*]NEW: Playground has been added! A level where you can learn more about turf wheel abilities and freely experiment with Beebz's entire moveset!
[*]NEW: Rollout & Glide now have separate thumbstick sensitivity sliders to compete with mouse users!
[*]NEW: You can now Y-invert only the glide move, flight stick mode!
[*]NEW: You can now optionally bind hotkeys to toggle to each specific turf ability.
[*]NEW: You can now wipe your game data in the settings.
[*]NEW: You can now map inputs directly to scroll up and scroll down for the mouse.

[*]EDIT: There is now a difficulty disclaimer under Trials display.
[*]EDIT: There is now a sign explaining the end of the tutorial level a bit more.
[*]EDIT: The button mapping menu is now bigger & easier to read.

[*]FIX: The upload failsafe, if your first upload didn't work, works now. We think.
[*]FIX: There is now a failsafe for failed Trial downloads where it will try downloading it again.
[*]FIX: A bunch of other stuff probably.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967636/81d1c64dbb9bf09282e97b269c7afa60c238eaaf.png[/img]

notes.title: Y'all rule, here's a patch!
notes.content:
[b]'Sup Demon Turf Champions! [/b]We see those scores and we are MIGHTY impressed. It's been great hearing everyone's enthusiasm and our community is thriving on Discord! ([url=https://discord.gg/fabraz]Join us![/url])

We also carefully listened to feedback to squash some bugs and improve some experiences, check out the new patch with these patch notes:
[list]
[*] New: Leaderboards are now scrollable!
[*] New: Upload status text added to win screen leaderboard button, alongside retry logic if the upload fails.
[*] New: Improved network connection handling for errors such as failed logins or uploads.
[*] New: Music persists across restarts!
[*] New: Toggle turf ability setting remembers previous ability persists across scenes.
[*] Fix: Win Screen displays proper previous best time (local, not leaderboard time).
[*] Fix: Look sensitivity values properly set from settings.
[*] Fix: Title screen submenus no longer toggle able while open.
[*] Fix: Camera angle is consistent between first spawn and respawns.
[*] Fix: Fixed glide boost reset bug.
[*] Fix: Fixed potential null ref with dialogue window with certain regions.
[*] More fixes for network connection logic.
[/list]

BONUS ROUND! We squashed a few more:
[list]
[*] Leaderboard upload failsafe: Your best time will be uploaded later, like on a restart of a game, if it failed to submit initially! No more lost times! <3
[*] Fixed two techs that were ILLEGAL!
[*] Button Mapping now remembers your choices after reopening the game
[*] Other minor fixes like improved slide triggering on rotating platforms
[/list]

Now onwards, win this week's trial! You only have a few more days left until the next one begins, THIS Friday! Hype!
